textTemplates.name: comprehensionworkshops
textTemplates.text:
The comprehension workshops set the tone and lay the foundation for personal and professional development. They are a combination of competency-based and transformation tools, which help participants navigate through shared experiences, identifying areas of behavior, opening doors to vulnerability, building trust, self-discovery, and self-worth. Participants will leave armed with an arsenal of tools that enhance healthy personal and professional relationships and self-love.

Below you can find a description of each of Cara's comprehension workshops.


  • First Impressions - Finding, getting, and keeping a job that leads to a career is important; however, without clear communication skills, this task can be daunting. It takes as little as 7 seconds to make a positive or negative first impression. Participants are given a bird's eye view through the use of visual performance and class discussion. They will walk away equipped with the knowledge that opinions and biases are formed the moment that someone meets them, based off of their appearance, body language, demeanor, mannerisms, etc., thus showing others their will, desire, and commitment to personal and professional change.

  • Conflict Management - Participants will build understanding, eliminate barriers, give voice to identities, and find commonalities amongst each other through an activity that will allow everyone to become more aware of themselves and their peers. One will be able to identify the similarities and differences we have amongst each other; acknowledge and address those differences; and bring to the surface other differences that we may not have recognized. A strong emphasis will be placed on having an understanding that we are more alike than we are different.

  • Communication - Identifying the difference between verbal and non-verbal communication, in addition to active listening is the scope for our communication workshop. Through a blend of presentation and discussion, students will learn techniques for effective communication. They will be presented with the tools on how to be an expert communicator and an active listener, who conveys information clearly in their own language and does so in an appropriate way in different situations. Participants will also learn how to better understand and connect with people around them and improve their ability to exchange ideas with others for greater and more collaborative productivity.

  • Community Commitments - Participants will be presented with ways to demonstrate what chaos and confusion looks like, while working within a community of peers. They will also explore the idea that, "I can't show you what works if you don't see what isn't working"; thus, creating a roadmap that works for everyone. Participants will engage in a meaningful discourse about what rules and norms the community will operate with and will each have to assert ideas and make concessions in order to achieve a fair and balanced consensus.

  • Love - Participants will be recognizing the power of love through personal and shared experiences by identifying who they love, thus setting into place an emotional tone that can generate connectedness of self and others. This activity aids towards building a healthy relationship with either those we hurt or those who hurt us. It also allows room for the participant to take steps towards inner healing in order to move forward personally and professionally in life.

  • Forgiveness - The power behind forgiveness will be introduced as a way to help one free themselves from bitterness and anger from their past. They will be provided the opportunity to release any hurt, pain, anger, or sadness that they have been holding onto, be it over the years or within the past few months. By sharing these feelings with fellow classmates, others begin to make the connection that they are not alone in their trials and will be presented with the tools that aid one to move forward. Thus, participants can take the steps to release the weights that have been holding them captive in their personal and professional lives.

textTemplates.text:
{!evalquestion4}Positive Attitude: Consistency demonstrates a positive attitude, including body language, facial expressions, and verbal response.
{!evalquestion5}Information Sharing: Provides factual information about Cleanslate, Cleanslate partners, and recycling. Takes every opportunity to greet and actively encourage residents to recycle.
{!evalquestion6}Understands Work: Has a full understanding of routes and/or instruction before starting a task. Asks questions for clarity.
{!evalquestion7}Professional Communication: Professional tone and direct eye contact. Makes proper introduction. Closes with a 'thank you' and a handshake.
{!evalquestion8}Customer Service Pitch: Knows the written customer service pitch and its constituents.

{!evalquestion15}Conflict Management: Utilizes the three basics of conflict management (pause, listen, and create a solution).

textTemplates.text:
{!evalquestion9}Preparedness: Uniform meets standards by having all articles of uniform and is neat and clean, boots shined, and is prepared for roll call with topic and song.

{!evalquestion11}Follows Safety Procedures: Follows and adheres to all safety procedures and takes necessary precautions while at the work site.
{!evalquestion12}Completes Tasks as Directed: Completes work as direct by supervisor or work order.

textTemplates.name: evalteamwork
textTemplates.text:
{!evalquestion16}Energy & Extra Motivation: Shows energy and extraordinary motivation throughout the workday.
{!evalquestion17}Goes Above & Beyond: Performs additional tasks/chores before or after each workday and approved by supervisor.
{!evalquestion18}Assists Others: Takes advantage of any opportunity to assist another field service representative in completing a task. Participants in loading and unloading of vehicles on routes or at the work site.

textTemplates.name: evaltimemgmt

{!evalquestion3}Meets Standards in a Timely Manner: Assigned route/work area is serviced to Cleanslate's standards in a timely manner, including debris, snow, grass, sign removal, etc.

textTemplates.name: virtualworkshops
textTemplates.text:
Below you can find a description of each of Cara's virtual workshops.


  • Policies and Procedures - A workshop to review Cara's policies and procedures. Participants will learn of the resources available during their job search as well as the expectations of participants during engagement.

  • Cara Central Tutorial - Led by Cara's Student Development Coordinator, this workshop is offered virtually every Tuesday from 3 PM - 4 PM. Participants and staff are welcome to join us each week to ask questions, review how to login and navigate the system, and learn about all of the information and available offerings in the Cara Central portal.

  • Experience Workshops - External corporate partners will lead these sessions to share their expertise and specific content aimed at providing support, tips, and insights as it relates to a participant's job search and career development. Previous topics have included "Navigating the Digital Application Process" and "LinkedIn Rock Your Profile: Coaching Session".

  • Employment Services Team Q&A - Join these bi-weekly workshops to hear from members of Cara's Employment Services Team who work closely with companies looking to fill job opportunities. We will discuss the current job market, interview activity, and recent job offers. The Employment Services Team will share tips, such as how to standout in your job search and how to respond to certain interview questions. This is also forum to ask Cara staff members any questions you may have regarding your job search.

  • Self-Directed Job Search Introduction - Led by Cara's Student Development Coordinator, this workshop will cover the following:
    • Research and applying for jobs in addition to your work with the Employment Services team
    • Tracking your applications in Cara Central
    • Preparing for interviews and networking with the support of Cara volunteers
    • What to do if you are offered a self-secured job to maintain your relationship with Cara

  • Self-Directed Job Search - Online Job Search - There are so many tools available for online job search, and it can be overwhelming. This workshop will break down the process and offer some tips and tricks to make it easier. We will take a look at the best websites, best practices, and managing your time effectively.
